# Theme fixtures

uQ `tokens.json` files for four of its themes, in the shape uqd writes
(`asafelobotomy/uq`, `crates/uq-core/src/theme.rs`). Used by the theme parser
tests and the screenshot run (`make gui-shots`). Palettes: Gruvbox by Pavel
Pertsev (MIT); Rosewood, Graphite and Matcha authored for uQ (MIT).
